warnings.message: The canonical model is derived from IDoc 0000000000123457 (ORDERS05) alone. This interchange carries 2 IDoc(s); the remaining 1 are described here and nowhere else.

Record and field offsets are computed under assumptions this file does not state: One character per byte position — a single-byte code page. A multi-byte character in a value shifts every offset after it. The control record is the 524-character EDI_DC40 layout and each data record the 1063-character EDI_DD40 layout (a 63-character header and 1000 characters of SDATA) of SAP release 4.0 and later; the release 2.x EDI_DC/EDI_DD layouts are not read. Trailing blanks are padding and are removed from values; leading blanks are kept. A data record shorter than its layout lost trailing blanks only, so its SDATA is padded back with blanks — a record truncated in the middle of a value cannot be told apart. Segment-definition offsets are 0-based within SDATA, as the definition file states them.

No segment definition was supplied for E1EDK01, E1EDK02, E1EDK17, E1EDKA1, E1EDKT1, E1EDKT2, E1EDP01, E1EDP19, E1EDP26, E1EDPT1, E1EDPT2, E1EDS01, so each one's SDATA is recorded as a single opaque value. Supply the segment definition (a WE60 export) beside the IDoc to read its fields.
